county.title: Which county is yours?
county.body: You just saw what it takes to put a measure on a county's ballot. To tell you the number for yours, and who is funding what is already on it, we need to know where you vote.
county.cite: Tocqueville: local institutions are where citizens actually learn the practice of liberty. The county is not a design convenience.
county.privacyLead: Your address is never shown publicly.
county.privacyBody: It resolves to a county and a set of districts, and that is all it is used for. You can delete it at any time and keep the account.
county.skip: Skip and show me California instead

threshold.title: Here is what it takes in {{county}}.
threshold.body: The figure below is 10% of the ballots cast for Governor in {{year}}. That many signatures compel the Board of Supervisors to adopt an ordinance as written, or put it to the voters. Those are its only two options.
threshold.waitingTitle: Working out which county that is.
threshold.waitingBody: Your address is being matched against the county boundaries. This takes a moment, and you can carry on without waiting for it.
threshold.noAddressBody: You can add one later from settings, and the county figures are on the front page for every county in the state in the meantime.
threshold.noMatchTitle: We do not have a threshold for that county yet.
threshold.noMatchBody: California counties are loaded and verified against the Secretary of State's own figures. If yours is outside California, or newly added, it is not there yet.

topics.title: What are you actually watching?
topics.subtitle: Pick three. Civic attention is finite, and three is roughly the number of issues a person can follow closely enough to act on: write, show up, sign, or decline to.
topics.reasonBody: Dewey, 1927: the public is not absent, it is eclipsed, unable to recognize itself or trace which decisions affect it. The remedy is not better citizens but better conditions of inquiry. Three issues you can follow beats twelve you can only scroll past. You can broaden this later in settings.

veteran.title: One sensitive question.
veteran.subtitle: This is the only sensitive field we ask about, and it gets its own screen so it cannot slip past inside a list of others.
veteran.lockedNote: Already set from a previous visit. To remove it, manage your privacy in settings.
veteran.noFieldsToggle: Never store sensitive fields about me
veteran.noFieldsNote: Turning this on removes anything already stored and stops us asking again.

disclosure.whyWeAsk: Veteran status surfaces bills on healthcare, benefits and housing protections that affect you directly. It is stored encrypted, never shown publicly, and never used to target you politically.

expectations.title: What you will actually get.
expectations.body: Some of this is running now. Some of it is being built, and we would rather say so than let you find out by its absence.

threshold.title: Your county's threshold
threshold.body: The signature count, what it is drawn from, and how it compares to the other 57.

propositions.title: State propositions
propositions.body: Every measure on the California ballot, in plain language, beside the text it came from.

bills.title: Statewide bills
bills.body: Every bill moving through the Legislature, with the three topics you picked deciding what surfaces first.

committees.title: Legislative committees
committees.body: Which committee a bill sits in, who is on it, and what they have voted on.

finance.title: Campaign finance
finance.body: Contributions and expenditures traced to the committee that filed them.

representatives.title: Your representatives
representatives.body: Who represents you at each level, and how they voted.

countyMeasures.title: County measures and meetings
countyMeasures.body: Your county's own ballot items and board agendas. We are working county by county, and yours may not be there yet.

petitions.title: Petition verification
petitions.body: Point your camera at a petition to check whether it is a real, filed measure.

expectations.notifyLead: You will hear from us when something changes:
expectations.notifyBody: a measure qualifies, a committee files, your board schedules a vote. Not on a schedule, and not otherwise.
